title: TechFest 2025: Innovation Expo and Hackathon
description: TechFest 2025 brings together innovators for an expo, keynote sessions, workshops, and a 24-hour hackathon. Join students, researchers, and industry experts for demos, talks, and networking.

title: AI Summit: Applied ML in Education
description: A focused summit on practical ML/AI adoption in academic settings. Featuring hands-on sessions, case studies, and panel discussions with practitioners.

title: Robotics Workshop: From Idea to Proto
description: Two-day workshop covering mechanical design, control, and embedded basics, ending with a functional prototype demo.

title: Startup Day: Pitches, Mentoring, Networking
description: Early-stage founders showcase ideas, get mentor feedback, and connect with peers and investors.

title: Data Science Workshop 2025
description: Learn data analysis, visualization, and machine learning basics through hands-on projects and expert guidance.

title: Web Development Bootcamp
description: Intensive bootcamp covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and full-stack development with industry mentors.
